body.name: \(\operatorname{CP}_{\rho}(k;n)\)
body.construction: For \(0<\rho<1\), its lower endpoint is \(0\) when \(k=0\) and otherwise is the unique \(p\in(0,1)\) satisfying \(P\{\operatorname{Bin}(n,p)\ge k\}=\rho/2\); its upper endpoint is \(1\) when \(k=n\) and otherwise is the unique \(p\in(0,1)\) satisfying \(P\{\operatorname{Bin}(n,p)\le k\}=\rho/2\).
